Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide. Our global team of over 10,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon. At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success. To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed—while embracing every step of the journey. Be part of the future of iGaming with 10,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here! ABOUT THE ROLE: As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of clients, supporting their needs, and driving long-term partnerships. You will play a key role in maintaining strong relationships, ensuring smooth integrations, and contributing to revenue growth. This role can be based in Malta, Dubai, Serbia or Gibraltar. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction and loyalty. Support client onboarding and guide them through integrations and product launches. Work with internal teams to deliver timely solutions and meet client needs. Collect, organize, and share promotions from providers with clients. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling products and services. Provide regular updates and KPI reports to clients and management. Monitor the respective iGaming market and advise clients on relevant opportunities. Resolve client issues quickly and effectively to maintain service excellence. Participate in industry events and client meetings when required. WHAT WE ASK OF YOU: 1–2 years’ experience in Account Management, Business Development, or Customer Success (iGaming industry experience is a must). Track record of building client relationships and contributing to account growth. Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills. Commercially minded with good analytical and problem-solving abilities. Fluent in Spanish and English (spoken and written). Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with CRM/project tools is a plus. A proactive, adaptable, and professional approach to work Willingness to travel for client meetings and business events. WHAT WE GIVE YOU IN RETURN: A detailed company training on highest standards. A chance to work in friendly and supportive culture. Tremendous growth opportunities in a large fast moving international company. Grow with ARRISE | Learning Hub—personalized learning, gamified growth, and endless career development at your fingertips. Private health insurance Breakfast & lunch provided once a week in the office Cloudigo app discounts Wellness allowance

new_matches.title: AI Value Creation Senior Principal
new_matches.job_function: Sales, General Business, and Customer Service
new_matches.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Dublin, Ireland; Warsaw, Poland . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 10 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role. Experience with AI technology, and GCP AI products or similar industry products. Experience managing and influencing business executive stakeholders. Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of value selling methodology and processes, opportunities, value chain, and value realization across cloud technology. Understanding of cloud sales and services, and a passion for AI. Ability to work with customers to deliver true business value and financial business cases for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) products and platforms in their language. Ability to operate effectively in a fluid, constantly-evolving team environment. Excellent presentation, communication and facilitation skills. About The Job As a Senior AI Value Creation Principal, you will be responsible for developing and driving the value promoting methodology for Google’s AI and Workspace products. You will collaborate with and influence global sales and product teams by using these strategies to accelerate Google Solution adoption. This role combines foundational AI understanding, enterprise business experience, and the ability to translate products into near and long term business impact for the customer. Success in this role means increased Google Cloud books and business across strategic product areas, and accelerated strategic partnerships. In this role, you will influence executive internal and external stakeholders, and articulate Google Cloud’s differentiators with credibility. As the technology landscape continues to evolve, you will need to artfully navigate change and ambiguity, test new ideas, and pivot when necessary. Google Cloud helps millions of employees and organizations empower their employees, serve their customers, and build what’s next for their business – all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are engineered for security, reliability, and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. And our teams are dedicated to helping our customers – developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions, and government agencies – see the benefits of our technology come to life. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Ireland: €144000 - €147000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits Poland: zł440000 - zł451000 (PLN) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits Responsibilities Learn more about benefits at Google . Develop and iterate on a value selling methodology across Google’s AI products. Work cross-functionally to drive broad-based adoption of value selling assets, insights, and resources. Collaborate with global sales, product, and customer stakeholders to craft compelling value propositions that demonstrate tangible and measurable impact of our technology. Lead customer centric value pitches development, business cases and TCO analysis, and scalable value templates. Leveraging Google, customer, and third-party data, frameworks, models, and tools to justify and accelerate customers’ investment decisions Brief Cloud sales and engineering leadership on customer patterns and emerging trends in AI, based on customer value engagements. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

new_matches.title: Coordenador de Serviço/ Service Desk
new_matches.description: 🎯 A Aurion é uma empresa de Tecnologias de Informação que tem por missão prestar serviços de consultoria, desenvolvimento, implementação e manutenção de sistemas de informação que contribuem para o progresso da sociedade e para os objetivos dos nossos Clientes. O que procuramos? Estamos a recrutar um(a) Técnico(a) de Customer Care / Service Desk & Desktop Management para integrar um projeto na área de suporte técnico e microinformática, em Lisboa. Procuramos um perfil com experiência em suporte presencial e remoto a utilizadores, resolução de incidentes, hardware, sistemas operativos e gestão de tickets , com capacidade de atuar de forma autónoma e de acompanhar operacionalmente as necessidades do cliente. 💻 O que vais fazer? Prestar suporte de microinformática aos utilizadores, maioritariamente de forma presencial; diagnosticar e resolver incidentes e pedidos relacionados com PCs, laptops, periféricos e equipamentos informáticos; efetuar instalação e preparação de imagens em equipamentos; realizar patching de rede em bastidores ; prestar suporte a impressoras e outros periféricos; atualizar tickets com o detalhe das ações e verificações realizadas; prestar suporte remoto sempre que aplicável; coordenar tarefas e incidentes da equipa; acompanhar escalamentos e necessidades operacionais com o cliente; apoiar a gestão de férias e ausências da equipa; elaborar relatórios operacionais e participar em reuniões de acompanhamento com o cliente; deslocar-te entre os diferentes sites do cliente, de acordo com as necessidades do serviço. ✍ Requisitos: Experiência em Service Desk, Desktop Management, Field Support ou suporte de microinformática ; conhecimentos sólidos de Microsoft Windows e macOS ; bons conhecimentos de hardware e periféricos ; capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting; noções de redes informáticas ; experiência na gestão e acompanhamento de tickets e incidentes; capacidade de coordenação, organização e priorização de tarefas; autonomia para trabalhar em ambientes exigentes e, pontualmente, sem apoio técnico imediato; boa capacidade de comunicação e contacto com cliente; conhecimentos de inglês ; carta de condução válida em Portugal e viatura própria ; disponibilidade para deslocações; disponibilidade para integrar regime de prevenção. ⭐ Será valorizado: Conhecimentos ou certificação ITIL ; experiência em suporte técnico presencial e remoto; experiência em coordenação operacional de equipas ou atividades de suporte; experiência em contexto de cliente empresarial. 📍 Lisboa – Oeiras | Regime presencial 💡 Benefícios: Integração num projeto desafiante em ambiente empresarial; remuneração competitiva e progressão de carreira; formação contínua e acompanhamento Aurion; seguro de saúde. 📨 Interessado/a? Envia o teu CV para marta.reis@aurionfirst.ai ou candidata-te através do link!
